hero.title: Manage All Your Students
hero.subtitle: With EduTakip, easily and professionally manage your tutoring business — from lesson planning and financial tracking to progress reports and an AI-powered assistant.

features.title: Everything in One Place
features.subtitle: Powerful tools that simplify every step of private tutoring, all in one platform.

lessonMgmt.title: Lesson Management
lessonMgmt.desc: Easily schedule lessons, record topics and notes. Supports face-to-face and online lesson types. Add recurring lessons automatically.

studentMgmt.title: Student Management
studentMgmt.desc: Track all your students in a card view. Access grade level, hourly fee, monthly earnings and balance information at a glance.

finance.title: Financial Tracking
finance.desc: View your monthly income charts, track pending payments and analyze earnings per student. Create regular income projections.

reports.title: Progress Reports
reports.desc: Create detailed progress reports after each lesson. Define topics covered, assessments, homework and the next lesson goal. Share with parents.

calendar.title: Smart Calendar
calendar.desc: Track all your lessons in weekly and daily views. Instantly update lesson status (completed, absent, cancelled).

ai.title: AI-Powered Assistant
ai.desc: Get instant answers to questions like "Who hasn't paid this month?", "What are my lessons today?", "Which students are struggling most?"

howItWorks.title: Get Started in 3 Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Set up in minutes and start using right away.

step1.title: Add Your Students
step1.desc: Easily save student information, parent contact details, weekly schedule and financial details with a 4-step wizard interface. A unique invite code is generated for each student.

step2.title: Plan Your Lessons
step2.desc: Create new lessons in seconds via the calendar or the "Schedule Lesson" button. Set topic, fee, location and lesson type. Use "Add to next weeks too" for recurring lessons.

step3.title: Track and Grow
step3.desc: Check your daily summary from the overview panel, analyze your income from the finance screen, document student progress with reports, and ask your AI assistant anything.

screenshots.title: Modern and User-Friendly
screenshots.subtitle: An intuitive and elegant teacher panel that works seamlessly on all devices.

sections.title: 1. Scope of Service
sections.body: EduTakip is a management platform for private tutors. The platform provides tools such as student tracking, lesson planning, financial management, progress reports and parent communication.

sections.title: 2. Membership and Account
sections.body: By registering on the platform, you are deemed to have accepted these terms. You are responsible for the security of your account; do not share your password with anyone.

sections.title: 3. Subscription and Payment
sections.body: The free plan offers service for up to 3 active students. The Pro plan charges a monthly fee per active student. A 30-day free trial is offered. Payment renews automatically; you will be charged for the next period unless you cancel.

sections.title: 4. Cancellation and Refund
sections.body: You may cancel your subscription at any time. Your access to the platform continues until the end of the current period. For our refund policy, please review our separate Refund Policy page.

sections.title: 5. Data and Privacy
sections.body: Student and parent information entered into the system is exclusive to you and is not shared with other users. For detailed information, please review our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 6. Usage Restrictions
sections.body: You may not use the platform for illegal purposes, in ways that harm third parties, or in a manner that overloads the system. Violations may result in account suspension.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: EduTakip does not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation of the platform. Maximum liability for data losses due to technical failures is limited to one month's subscription fee.

sections.title: 8. Changes
sections.body: These terms may be updated without prior notice. You can access current terms on the platform. Continued use of the platform means you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: For questions, you can reach us at support@edutakip.com.

sections.title: 1. Data Collected
sections.body: Data such as name-surname, email, student information, lesson records and payment history are collected. This data is used solely for the purpose of providing services.

sections.title: 2. Use of Data
sections.body: Collected data is processed to provide platform access, improve service quality and provide technical support. It is not used for advertising or third-party marketing.

sections.title: 3. Data Security
sections.body: Your data is stored with SSL encryption on secure servers. Technical and administrative measures are taken against unauthorized access.

sections.title: 4. Sharing with Third Parties
sections.body: Your personal data will not be shared with third parties without your explicit consent, except for legal obligations.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.body: The platform uses cookies for session management and preference records. You can manage your cookie settings from your browser.

sections.title: 6. Retention Period
sections.body: Your data is retained while your account is active. Upon account deletion request, all your data will be removed from the system within 30 days.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights (KVKK)
sections.body: Under Law No. 6698 (KVKK), you have the right to access, correct, delete and transfer your data. You can apply to support@edutakip.com for your requests.

sections.title: 8. Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related questions, you can write to support@edutakip.com.

sections.title: 1. Free Trial Period
sections.body: A 30-day free trial is offered to all new users. No charges are made during this period and no refund request is needed for cancellation.

sections.title: 2. Right to Refund
sections.body: You may request a full refund within 14 days of the payment date without stating any reason. Send your refund request to support@edutakip.com and it will be processed within 5-10 business days.

sections.title: 3. Cancellation
sections.body: You may cancel your subscription at any time. Upon cancellation, you will retain access to the service until the end of the current billing period.

sections.title: 4. Refund Process
sections.body: To request a refund, send an email to support@edutakip.com. Valid requests are processed within 5-10 business days and refunded to your original payment method.

sections.title: 5. Contact
sections.body: For refund requests and questions, you can reach us at support@edutakip.com. Working hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 (Turkey time).
